description: This Perl module defines the Coocook::Schema::Component::ProxyMethods class, providing shorthand methods to call ResultSource or Schema methods, mainly for date/time formatting/parsing, transactions, and boolean formatting within the Coocook schema.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Component::ProxyMethods
classes.description: A class providing shorthand methods for date/time formatting, parsing, transaction execution, and boolean formatting within the Coocook schema.

methods.name: format_date
methods.description: Formats a date using the schema's datetime parser.

methods.name: format_datetime
methods.description: Formats a datetime using the schema's datetime parser.

methods.name: format_date_today
methods.description: Formats today's date using the schema's datetime parser.

methods.name: format_datetime_now
methods.description: Formats the current datetime using the schema's datetime parser.

methods.name: parse_date
methods.description: Parses a date string into a DateTime object.

methods.name: parse_datetime
methods.description: Parses a datetime string into a DateTime object.

methods.name: txn_do
methods.description: Executes a transaction within the schema.

methods.name: format_bool
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to 1 or 0.
